title: add git support
description:
build git integration

The idea is that tct should automatically commit the current .tct contents.
For the commit message, it should in the first line say which boards have been updated. if only a single card has been updated, it could mention that.

The details could describe which cards have been updated in particular (very concisely, not in detail)

the titles of boards/cards/lists should be used 

git integration should be required to be activated explicitly with `tct --git enable|disable`

tct init should automatically detect whether to enable or disable git depending on whether the newly created .tct folder is in a git repo or not. but it should also allow overriding that with --git enable|disable and it should output whether it has been enabled or not.

before implementing, list pros and cons and propose a design as well as alternatives.
